description: Create an empty tax group (a tax profile that products get assigned to, e.g. "Standard", "Food", "Zero-rated"). Call get_taxes FIRST — a second group with the same meaning splits the catalogue and is a common way to end up charging two different taxes for one thing. The group charges nothing until you add rates with create_tax_rate or add_tax_rate_to_group, and no product uses it until someone assigns it. isStandard marks the company default — set it only if the merchant explicitly says so. CONFIRM the name with the merchant before calling.

isStandard.description: Make this the company default group. Default false

name.description: What the merchant calls it, e.g. "Standard Tax"

name: hub_create_tax_group
title: Create tax group
